mailboxId.description: Short opaque identifier returned by outlook.list_mailboxes.v1.

anchor.description: The message the conversation is resolved from.

internetMessageId.description: RFC 5322 Message-ID of the anchor message, including angle brackets, as reported by outlook.list_emails.v1. Not the Office.js conversationId.

maxMessages.description: Cap on the number of returned messages. When the conversation has more, the result is reported as partial.
